name: YouTube cut
why: A shorter cut for YouTube, kept beside the director's cut: no title card (the film starts on the 6:14 alarm) and about 61 s of wordless shot tails trimmed from the routine, the drive, the office, the heat and 5:37. Breakfast, the mirror scene, the routine montage, Q11 and Q12 are untouched. Every cut removes the end of a shot after its subtitle has gone, so nothing jumps; the soundtrack is rebuilt on the new clock (tools/youtube_cut.py), not chopped.
